worldcombat.skill.steelwing.summary: Sweep and push away enemies ahead, raising Defense on hit.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.0: Sweep a whole fan of foes in front
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.1: Sweep along the edge of an enemy cluster
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.use.2: Hone Defence a little with every landed sweep
The sweep deals about %1$s contact damage over a %2$s-degree fan in front; the foe's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled on hit.
The fan reaches %1$s blocks and shoves each hit target %2$s blocks away from the user.
After any landed sweep, %1$s chance to harden the wing and raise Defence by %2$s level.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.glide.on: Gliding sweep: slide forward before sweeping, with a wider fan, more knockback and a steadier Defence raise, but a longer windup and cooldown and a risk of sliding into the enemy line.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.glide.off: Grounded sweep: hold the ground and sweep in front; faster and cheaper, with a slightly narrower fan.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: sweep damage %2$s, up to %3$s Defence stage per cast.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.preference.g: On: slide forward before sweeping, with a wider fan, more knockback and a steadier Defence raise, but a longer windup and cooldown and a risk of sliding into the enemy line. Off (grounded): hold the ground and sweep in front; faster and cheaper, a slightly narrower fan.
worldcombat.skill.steelwing.preference.a: Only sweep when the foe is within this range; a larger value means closing in on a whole cluster more willingly.
On: sweep when others are clustered around the target, catching them all in one fan. Off: rank it like ordinary melee.
On: while Defence is below +4 stages, rank the sweep higher to harden the wing before taking hits. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
